description: Request that a human visits a location in a given time window and reports conditions such as noise, crowding, accessibility, mobile signal and cleanliness, with evidence. A commissioned job: a skilled, accountable human we brief for you – quoted individually, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

aspects.description: What to check, e.g. noise, crowding, accessibility, mobile_signal, cleanliness, light, parking, atmosphere/vibe.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

context.description: Optional: purpose, e.g. flat for a family with a baby.

name: request_condition_report
title: Request an on-site condition report
